_why: Reviewed exemptions for scripts/dev/engine-dir-writes.py, the push ratchet that refuses an address inside the engine checkout that the checkout's own .gitignore ignores (HOS-5 section 7, 2026-09-25). One entry per finding, keyed by the file plus the sha256 of the statement; an entry that matches nothing fails the run, and so does a finding no entry covers. There is no field for a file or a directory.

The crm-then-contacts address. A read, not a write: get_data_root() asks whether a crm directory holding contacts, or a knowledge directory, sits in the checkout so that, on an engine tree, it can refuse it as a data root and log a warning (HOS-168). Nothing is created at either address; the check exists to keep the leak guard armed when stray data appears in the engine.
